caption: The drawing depicts a long, formal coat with a rich burgundy or dark reddish-brown outer fabric and intricate light-colored embroidery along the collar, front edges, cuffs, and pocket flaps. The embroidery consists of floral patterns with green, white, and light purple accents. The lapels, cuffs, and hems are bordered by a repeating floral motif. The inside or lining of the coat is a pale beige or cream color, visible on the lower part and through the open front. The back of the coat, including detailed embroidery placement, is sketched in a smaller, less colored outline at the top right corner of the drawing. The drawing is presented on a plain, tan background.
title: Coat and Waistcoat
